column2: Ano ang pagkakaiba ng container at VM?
column4: container: lightweight, shares host OS, faster. VM: full OS, isolated, heavier.
gamitin ang Dockerfile: FROM node:18, COPY ., RUN npm install, CMD node server.js
consistent na environment across dev/staging/prod, easy scaling, fast deployment
ang pag-manage ng maraming containers: scaling, health checks, rolling updates — Kubernetes
docker run -d -p 3000:3000 myapp — i-run ang container sa background sa port 3000
